representations.name: Coupled degree-two canonical digits
representations.new_information: Writes alpha=C(a,2)+s and beta=C(b0,2)+t simultaneously, retaining both carries and the exact relation C(b0,2)+t-C(a,2)-s=(k-1)r+C(k-1,2)-1.
representations.first_test: Enumerate actual (++ -> ++) cells and minimize the exact cubic gap C(b0,3)+C(t,2)-C(a,3)-C(s,2)-1-C(a-1,3) by digit order type.

representations.name: Unit-increment carry path
representations.new_information: Expands U_2(beta)-U_2(alpha) as the sum of exact unit increments along the interval [alpha,beta), so resets and large carry jumps are visible rather than hidden by superadditivity.
representations.first_test: Freeze the minimum-margin state and compare the contribution of ordinary digit increments and triangular carries to e.

representations.name: Triangular-cap deficit pair
representations.new_information: Uses A0=C(a+1,2)-alpha and B0=C(b0+1,2)-beta, converting lower-digit tails into distances from the next carry and retaining the cancellation lost in lower bounds on beta-alpha alone.
representations.first_test: Test whether every actual target cell has a monotone relation between A0, B0 and b0-a strong enough to imply the cubic gap.

representations.name: Macaulay shadow defect
representations.new_information: Tracks D2(N)=C(top_2(N)+1,3)-U_2(N) together with N's cap deficit, allowing an exact decomposition of e into a leading-block gain minus two controlled defects.
representations.first_test: Evaluate the proposed defect domination at the earliest (++ -> ++) row and at target/gamma4 boundary endpoints through j=40.

representations.name: Scale-eliminated actual lattice
representations.new_information: Eliminates q using (k-1)q+C(k-1,2)+2-r=2h and keeps the exact residue class, preventing continuous asymptotics from admitting nonactual states.
representations.first_test: Derive lower and upper bounds for r at A=0, p=0 and gamma4=0 uniformly in h, then compare their separation.

representations.name: Target-wall normalized phase
representations.new_information: Normalizes displacement from the p=0 wall by the compatible-r step k-1 and records k/h powers, so the widening target chamber at large j is not sampled by a fixed offset window.
representations.first_test: Search for subsequential regimes in which the normalized G++ margin tends to zero or changes sign as h and k co-grow.

representations.name: Borrow-complete rank-six word
representations.new_information: Retains full canonical words for x1,y1 and explicitly renormalizes negative P or V, rather than declaring gamma6 undefined outside the no-borrow chart.
representations.first_test: Generate synthetic and actual gamma5-negative rows closest to P=0 and V=0 and compare full-orbit gamma6 with every proposed normalized branch.

representations.name: Scale-varying negative-fibre recurrence
representations.new_information: Indexes (-- -> ++) negative rows by dyadic scale and canonical digits instead of a fixed k,r box, exposing how the negative region expands while rank-six recovery changes.
representations.first_test: Continue exact low-r fibres through j=100 and fit only identities that survive changes in both k and r.

representations.name: Canonical order-type complex
representations.new_information: Partitions states by all inequalities among a,s,b0,t and the next-rank leading indices, making every binomial expression polynomial on a cell without assuming a finite numerical parameter box.
representations.first_test: Enumerate realized order types through increasing j and reject stabilization if a new type appears.

representations.name: Two-row lexicographic recovery potential
representations.new_information: Pairs surplus deficit with distance to the next borrow wall and canonical leading-gap growth, allowing a negative gamma5 row to certify progress toward gamma6 recovery.
representations.first_test: Demand strict improvement from rank five to rank six on every known negative fibre and falsify on the smallest equality or reversal.
